offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures water meters and flow measurement instruments, and sells cloud software for managing water data. Customers are mainly water utilities, along with industrial and commercial facilities, sold through utilities and direct accounts.

primary_products.value: water meters; ultrasonic flow meters; meter reading and communication devices; flow instrumentation and sensors

primary_services.value: cloud-based water data software; meter data analytics; advanced metering network support

customer_segment.value: B2B: water and gas utilities, industrial plants, commercial building owners, OEM equipment buyers; B2G: municipal water departments and public utilities

end_markets.value: water utilities; industrial processing; commercial buildings; chemical and food processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: meters and flow instruments sold to utilities and industrial customers; subscription: cloud software and data services for water management; service fees: installation support and network services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds meters and flow instruments from purchased components, sold to utilities and distributors; software / platform: hosted data platform sold on subscription to water utilities

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: water meters, flow instrumentation, and water data software sharing utility customers and technology

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: waterworks distributors supplying utilities and contractors; direct sales: direct sales to large utilities and industrial accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: meters must meet accuracy and drinking-water material standards such as AWWA and NSF/ANSI 61 and weights and measures approvals, data privacy rules apply to software
